dataset_title: Target Coordinates and SPHEREx Observation Research Template
source_note: This JSON preserves the target coordinates and field definitions found in the source document. Blank Gaia and SPHEREx observation fields have not been filled with estimated or invented values.

gaia_field_definitions.gaia_dr3_source_id: Gaia catalogue identifier; leave blank until a reliable Gaia source match is confirmed.
gaia_field_definitions.gaia_ra_deg: Gaia source right ascension in degrees.
gaia_field_definitions.pmra_mas_yr: Proper motion in right ascension, milliarcseconds per year.
gaia_field_definitions.pmdec_mas_yr: Proper motion in declination, milliarcseconds per year.
gaia_field_definitions.radial_velocity_km_s: Line-of-sight velocity in km/s, only if available.
gaia_field_definitions.gaia_match_status: Status of the Gaia source match.

observation_field_definitions.observation_number: Observation sequence number for this target.
observation_field_definitions.obs_id: Exact archive observation ID; do not infer dates from the ID.
observation_field_definitions.mjd_or_time_start: Observation start time or MJD from archive metadata.
observation_field_definitions.mjd_or_time_end: Observation end time or MJD from archive metadata.
observation_field_definitions.band_or_energy_bandpass: Observed bandpass; comparisons should use matching bands.
observation_field_definitions.s_ra_deg: Observation/image pointing right ascension in degrees.
observation_field_definitions.access_url_or_download_name: Archive access URL or downloaded product filename.
observation_field_definitions.product_type: For example, science image, cutout, or calibration product; verify from archive metadata.
observation_field_definitions.target_coverage_confirmed: Whether target coverage has been confirmed.
observation_field_definitions.same_band_pair_confirmed: Whether a comparable same-band observation pair has been confirmed.

research_guidance: The source document is a structured handoff/template, not proof that Gaia or SPHEREx matches or observations have been retrieved.
Use actual archive metadata for dates and observation IDs.
Leave unavailable values blank or mark them as 'Not yet retrieved'; never estimate them.
SPHEREx_Observations is described in the source document as the combined master table.
